The '''2009–10 Danish Superliga''' season was the 20th season of the [[Danish Superliga]] league championship, which determinates the winners of the [[Danish football champions]]hip. It is governed by the [[Danish Football Association]]. The tournament started on 18 July 2009 and concluded on 16 May 2010.

The Danish champions qualify for [[2010–11 UEFA Champions League]] qualification. Runners-up and 3rd placed team qualify for [[2010–11 UEFA Europa League]] qualification. The 11th and 12th placed teams will be relegated to the [[Danish 1st Division|1st Division]]. The 1st Division champions and runners-up will be promoted to the Superliga.

On 5 May 2010, [[FC Copenhagen]] (''FC København'') won the title for the eighth time in 17 years after defeating [[HB Køge]] 4–0.<ref>{{cite news|publisher=David Hunke; [[Gannett Company]]|location=[[Copenhagen]]|url=https://www.usatoday.com/sports/soccer/2010-05-05-4203949832_x.htm|title=FC Copenhagen secures Danish title with 4–0 win|date=2010-05-05|work=[[USA Today]]|access-date=2010-05-06}}</ref>

==Season statistics==

===Scoring===
* First goal of the season: [[Stephan Petersen]] for [[FC Nordsjælland|Nordsjælland]] against [[F.C. Copenhagen|Copenhagen]] (18 July 2009)
* Fastest goal in a match: [[Peter Graulund]] (16 seconds) for [[Aarhus Gymnastikforening|AGF]] against [[AaB Fodbold|AaB]] (20 July 2009)
* Widest Winning Margin: [[F.C. Copenhagen|Copenhagen]] 7–1 [[HB Køge]] (25 July 2009)
* Most Goals in a Match: [[Brøndby IF|Brøndby]] 6–3 [[FC Nordsjælland|Nordsjælland]] (4 October 2009)
* First [[hat-trick]] of the season: [[Rajko Lekic]] for [[Silkeborg IF|Silkeborg]] against [[FC Midtjylland|Midtjylland]] (26 July 2009)

===Cards===
* First yellow card: [[Benjamin Kibebe]] for [[FC Nordsjælland|Nordsjælland]] against [[F.C. Copenhagen|Copenhagen]] (18 July 2009)
* First red card: [[Tim Janssen]] for [[Esbjerg fB|Esbjerg]] against [[Brøndby IF|Brøndby]] (26 July 2009)
* Fastest red card in a match: [[Johan Absalonsen]] (55 minutes) for [[Odense Boldklub|OB]] against [[Aarhus Gymnastikforening|AGF]] (3 August 2009)

== Venues ==
The [[Danish Football Association]] has listed a number of requirements to the venues hosting Superliga football. These include a minimum capacity of 10,000, hereof at least 3,000 seats. Further is under-soil heating a demand. It is possible for a club to get dispensation for some of the requirements for a year, after promotion to the league.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://dbu.dk/data/dbu/filedb/127.pdf |title=Krav til danske fodboldstadioner |publisher=[[Danish Football Association]] |access-date=2010-03-20 |language=da |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100216123859/http://www.dbu.dk/data/dbu/filedb/127.pdf |archive-date=16 February 2010 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
